title: Gorgeous 4BR Rosemary Beach Vacation Home with Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at McKenzie Cottage, a 4BR, 3 BA vacation home in Rosemary Beach, FL, with two covered porches, classic charm, and private beach access. Sleeps 10.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love* Tesla Charger w/ 18' Cable* 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes* Sonos Arc Soundbar, 3rd Gen Sonos Sub* Logitech Harmony Remote* Apple TV* Very family-friendly atmosphere* Two covered porches, one screened* Adirondack furnishings and porch swing* On West Kingston Park* Full-sized desk with monitor included for remote workThis gorgeous vacation home in Rosemary Beach will take you back to a kinder, gentler yesteryear. Reminiscent of an old-fashioned family neighborhood, you will love the mature trees, small park, and family-friendly atmosphere at McKenzie Cottage.With two covered porches, it’s easy to enjoy the Adirondack chairs and porch swing as you gaze out over the small neighborhood park. The wooden porch floors add to the timeless appeal.Once you get inside, however, you’ll realize there is nothing old-fashioned about this lovely home. While incorporating classic charms, such as the hardwood floors and natural fibers, everything is updated for the modern family and the way they live and vacation. From the marble counters to the wine cooler and the second ice maker, you will not be without in this well-appointed home.The open-concept great room, with its many windows, keeps the home awash in natural light. The living area boasts plenty of comfortable seating so that your family can hang out together, watching the large flat-screen TV, Apple TV, Sonos Arc Soundbar, Sub, and Harmony Remote to control it all. Soft recessed lighting and a cooling atmosphere create an ideal environment for making new family memories!The kitchen is both gracious and spacious! It will be a real joy for the family chef, utilizing the space beautifully with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, and a center island with seating for 2. A bonus butler’s pantry offers even more storage and working space.The formal dining table is adjacent to this space and offers seating for 8. Also conveniently located on this first level is a comfortable bedroom with a king-size bed, dual nightstands and lamps, and generous closet space. A full bath offers a large walk-in shower.The master bedroom suite is a lovely sanctuary. With a king-size bed, dual nightstands and lamps, a seating area with a side chair and ottoman, and a private balcony, one lucky couple will love retiring here in the evenings. The master bath is luxurious, with dual vanities and a walk-in shower.A third cozy bedroom also offers a king bed, seating area, flat-screen TV, and ceiling fan. The kid’s room is last but not least, with its two sets of built-in bunks. These two bedrooms share a full bath with dual vanities and a tub/shower.The landing on the second floor now has a full-sized desk and computer monitor for those who want to work remotely from our beautiful beaches.A home this family-friendly won’t stay available for long. Give us a call today for the best availability!FIRST FLOOR* Living room with large sectional sofa, side chair, coffee table, lamp, 4K TV, recessed lighting, ceiling fan* Kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, center island with seating for 2* Butler’s pantry with washer/dryer, beverage cooler, and dishwasher* Dining area with seating for 8* Covered porch with seating* BEDROOM with king-size bed, dual nightstands, and lamps* BATHROOM with walk-in shower and access to outdoor showerSECOND FLOOR* MASTER BEDROOM with king-size bed, dual nightstands, and lamps, two side chairs, one with ottoman, ceiling fan, Apple TV, Sonos Beam. MASTER BATHROOM with dual vanities and walk-in shower. * BEDROOM with king-size bed, seating area, flat-screen TV, ceiling fan* BEDROOM with two built-in bunk sets* BATHROOM with dual vanities and tub/shower* Covered porch with seatingSpring Break & Summer 2022: 7-night Saturday - SaturdayTDT-031466
